# Learnings and mistakes

No structural facts are generated for this page; the store has no concept of a mistake, only of records, decisions and handovers. Everything here is written by hand.

## Notes (human, preserved verbatim on regeneration)

<!-- bm-human:begin -->
1. THE CEREMONY SHIPPED A STALE BOARD FOR THREE DAYS. The pack copied
   docs/plan/COMMAND-CENTER.html, last written 2026-08-17, while the live
   board was docs/plan/GANTT.html. Nothing was lying on purpose: no rule kept
   the copied file current, and no page said which one was live. A copy whose
   freshness nothing enforces is a stale copy waiting to happen.
2. A FINISHED SESSION'S CLAIM STILL BLOCKS THE NEXT WRITER. An sbe task from
   a session whose close report read FINISHED still owned the manifest and
   the board, so the next writer could not regenerate CHECKSUMS. Its owner
   cleared it on request. Closing your own records is part of finishing, not
   an afterthought.
3. A REPAIR SCRIPT CHECKED THE WRONG DIMENSION. migrate_install.py reported
   NOTHING TO DO because it checks fence-hook wiring, while the actual
   failure was currency: the installed copy is 25 commits behind and a schema
   behind, which is why every sweep answers NO-DATA. A control that reports
   healthy about a dimension it never looks at is the same family as a
   control that cannot reach a verdict.
4. WORKTREE ISOLATION LEAKS THROUGH ROOT RESOLUTION. A tool run inside a
   worktree walked up, found the main checkout's marker, and wrote a real
   pack into the shared tree, then could not clean it up because its own
   sandbox refused. Queued as M16. Isolation is what makes parallel writers
   safe, so a silent escape from it is a safety bug, not a convenience bug.
5. THE PUBLIC-REPO WRITE FUNNEL MASKS ABSOLUTE PATHS. Generated pack text
   gets machine paths replaced with a withheld marker, which is correct for a
   public repository and means the portability preamble must TELL a reader
   how to find the paths rather than embed them.
6. Asking the founder for two decisions at once, while a builder ran, cost
   nothing and unblocked both. Founder-hand steps belong at hour zero, not at
   the close.
<!-- bm-human:end -->
